acceptance: The owner's choice between matching the Explorer and a named personal-history model is recorded.
For the same stored runs, `report rankings` either orders platforms as the Explorer does or states the rule it uses instead.
A benchmark without a local ranking metric is reported as not ranked locally, not as having no results.
context: Found while settling how a reopened TPC-DI appears in local rankings (five-whys analysis, 2026-11-28). The owner asked to treat this as a separate follow-up.
description:
## Problem
`benchbox report rankings` ranks platforms from the local results database (`ResultDatabase.calculate_rankings`, `benchbox/core/results/database.py:716`). Since the corpus-derived outcome rule (`docs/internal/adr/adr-corpus-derived-outcome-rule.md`), it shares only admission and lanes with the published corpus and Results Explorer (`outcome_from_stored_facts`, `admitted_for_ranking`). The rest differs:
- Score: the value recorded with each run (`_RANKING_METRIC_CONFIG`, `database.py:50-56`); the corpus recomputes the score from timings for every lane (ADR, planner decisions).
- Aggregation: mean of every run in the lookback window; the Explorer shows the median of the newest released version (ADR owner decision 4).
- Labels: no "Derived from TPC-H/TPC-DS ..." wording or class on ranked TPC rows (ADR guardrail); unclear whether the ADR covers the CLI.
- Metrics: a fixed list of query-timing formulas; a benchmark cannot declare its own primary metric, so benchmarks whose metric is not built from query times (TPC-DI's TPC_DI_RPS) cannot be ranked locally at all.
The same runs can therefore be ordered differently locally and in the Explorer. No decision chose this; the ADR is scoped to the corpus and the local database was migrated only as far as removing `compliance_class` (#4521) required.

## Decision gate (owner)
Should the local view match the Explorer (same score, aggregation, labels and lanes, from the same rule), or stay a personal-history tool with its own clearly named rules (and say so in its output and help)?

## Change (after the decision)
Implement the chosen model for every benchmark; give benchmarks a way to declare their ranking metric or an explicit "not ranked locally" status; keep the empty-result message truthful about why nothing was ranked.

## Out of scope
The TPC-DI-specific empty-result message, which the TPC-DI reopening fixes.
